## About
My name is Darrell Aberegg, and I started RainTreeUSA Irrigation Service & Repair as a side business to help support my kids going to college. I quickly grew a passion for the work and for helping people, and it turned into something bigger than a side gig.
My wife and I are natives of West Texas, with deep roots in the small town of Coahoma. In a town that size, a good or bad reputation spreads like wildfire. That's why we're in this business to build strong customer relations based on trust and reliable service.
RainTreeUSA is a Texas Licensed Irrigation Service and Backflow Testing company, rated 4.9 from 81 Google reviews by our neighbors.

## Services
- Sprinkler System Repair: Systems that quit working, leak or won't run right. One reviewer's system hadn't worked in years, and Darrell had it fixed, running and programmed.
- Sprinkler Head Repair: Rotors, sprays and drip, including Rainbird and Hunter heads. Busted heads fixed and the rest adjusted.
- Valves, solenoids and electrical: Valve and solenoid problems, plus electrical wire troubleshooting when zones won't come on.
- PVC and drip pipe repairs: Cracked or broken PVC and drip lines found and repaired.
- Smart Controller: Controllers and Wifi smart controllers set up and programmed, plus rain sensors.
- Annual Back Flow Test: Backflow testing for your irrigation system.
- Swimming Pool Back Flow Test: Backflow testing for swimming pool connections.
- Backflow Install | Replace: New backflow devices installed and old ones replaced.

## FAQ
Q: Do you charge by the hour?
A: No hourly rates. We only use brand name parts and won't nickel and dime you to install.

Q: What if the problem doesn't get fixed?
A: One reviewer said Darrell only charges for things he can resolve and won't charge unless it is resolved fully.

Q: Will you show me how to use my system?
A: One customer said Darrell had their system fixed, running, programmed, and gave them a full tutorial.

Q: What areas do you serve?
A: Austin, Cedar Park, Leander, Georgetown, Round Rock and Liberty Hill.
